messages:
yasmin: Opening an expedited hotfix for encoder routing causing sporadic 502s in eu-west1 (seen after config push). Built image encoder:v1.9.1-hotfix. No DB or schema changes. Request: lifeboat rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over next 30m. Need a quick ops thumbs-up + pin during rollback. /cc @raj_k @oncall-lee

raj_k: Please post deploy link, exact rollback steps, and whether this touches cache shards. Also propose auto-pause thresholds.

yasmin: Deploy: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1820000000. KV-cache unaffected (checked). Smoke tests green in staging. Perf: p95 +0.2% at worst. Rollback plan (manual + pin):
```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/encoder encoder=redwood/encoder:v1.9.0
# cut traffic back to previous deployment and pin version to avoid re-roll
curl -X POST https://orchestrator.internal/traffic -d '{"service":"encoder","version":"v1.9.0","percent":100}'
curl -X POST https://release-config.internal/pin -d '{"service":"encoder","version":"v1.9.0","reason":"rollback after hotfix"}'
```
I can run the pin command if we need rollback.

deploybot: Deploy request received for encoder:v1.9.1-hotfix. CI: \u2705 unit, \u2705 integration, e2e flaky (non-blocking). Proposed expedited canary: 10% for 4m, auto-pause if error_rate > 0.7% for 2m. Reply "approve" or react :thumbsup:.

ci-bot: Note: last e2e failure unrelated (upstream timeout).

oncall-lee: I'll be on pager for the next hour. I'm fine with expedited lifeboat if we enforce the 4m gate and have rollback owner ready. Enabling verbose logs now. +1

raj_k: I'll own rollback if needed. Adding circuit-breaker config: error_threshold=0.7%, window=2m, tail-latency alert >12%.

yasmin: added thresholds to rollout config and draft release note: "Hotfix: encoder routing fix — v1.9.1-hotfix." Posting to release-notes after green.

deploybot: Canary started at 1820000020 -> encoder:v1.9.1-hotfix @10% traffic. Canary link: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1820000000/canary. Health gate: 4m.

yasmin: Dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/encoder/encoder-health-eu. If error_rate >0.7% for 2m we auto-pause and run rollback playbook.

ci-bot: No e2e regressions observed during first 2m of canary.

oncall-lee: 3m into canary: error_rate 0.3%, p95 stable. Proceed to 50% for 3m. I'm watching traces.

deploybot: Ramp to 50% at 1820000048.

raj_k: monitoring: p95 +1%, error_rate 0.2%. All good.

yasmin: ramping to 100% as soon as 50% steady for 3m.

deploybot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1820000065.

yasmin: No rollback required. Publishing release note and tagging post-release actions. Thanks for the quick approvals. :rocket:

releasebot: Release note RN-501 published. Deploy ledger entry L-10021 marked expedited.

raj_k: Follow-up: will open a short blameless note on why config drift caused routing mismatch in eu-west1. Not a full incident, but capture learnings.

yasmin: Adding follow-up tasks to the post-release checklist.

deploybot: Deploy record closed and archived.
